name: Cisco Wireless (AireOS)
description: Cisco AireOS wireless LAN controllers (5508, 5520, 8540, 9800 in AireOS-compatible modes). Client, AP, CAPWAP, RADIUS, roaming, and RF troubleshooting.
notes: AireOS debug output is often sent to the console. Use an SSH/console session you can watch.
'debug disable-all' stops every debug on the controller and is the safety cleanup for these runbooks.
Client MAC addresses may be entered as 0011.2233.4455 or 00:11:22:33:44:55.

categories.name: AAA / RADIUS
categories.description: RADIUS servers, statistics, and authentication debug.

categories.name: Access points
categories.description: AP inventory, join state, and configuration.

categories.name: System health
categories.description: Controller CPU, memory, interfaces, and logs.

workflows.title: Client detail and state
workflows.summary: Inspect a client's authentication, IP, AP, RSSI, and policy state.

workflows.title: Client debug — one MAC
workflows.summary: Enable client-specific debugging, reproduce the join or roaming issue, then disable all debugs.

steps.instruction: Start a console or SSH session you can watch. AireOS debug output may not appear in every session.
Reconnect or roam the client, then inspect its detail and the message log.

notes: The cleanup disables all wireless debugs, not just this client.

workflows.title: RADIUS / dot1x debugs
workflows.summary: Enable AAA, RADIUS, and dot1x debugging for an authentication failure.

steps.instruction: Have the client authenticate now, then inspect the log and client detail.

notes: These are global AAA debugs. Use a short window to avoid overwhelming the controller.

workflows.title: RADIUS server status
workflows.summary: Check RADIUS server configuration, ports, and authentication statistics.

workflows.title: AP inventory and join state
workflows.summary: Inspect AP inventory, configuration, and join statistics.
steps: show ap join stats summary all

workflows.title: CAPWAP debugs — AP join failures
workflows.summary: Enable CAPWAP control and packet debugs while an AP attempts to join.

steps.instruction: Reboot or reconnect the AP, then watch the join attempt.

steps: show ap join stats summary all
notes: If the AP never appears, check DHCP option 43, DNS, and UDP 5246/5247 reachability first.

workflows.title: Roaming and mobility
workflows.summary: Check mobility state, the client's current AP, and roaming history.

workflows.title: RF health for an AP
workflows.summary: Inspect the AP's radio configuration and automatic RF statistics.

workflows.title: Controller interface and system health
workflows.summary: Check controller interfaces, CPU, memory, and version.

workflows.title: DHCP for wireless clients
workflows.summary: Inspect DHCP proxy state and the client's address assignment.

workflows.title: WLAN configuration and clients
workflows.summary: Verify the WLAN, its interface, security policy, and connected clients.
